payload.title: not-before deferral gate is honored by 1 of 4 pickers — ILC/RLC/SECONDARY dispatch time-gated rows anyway

evidence.note: All four import devteam-eligibility.jq, so the helper is IN SCOPE for all of them; three simply never invoke it. Importing the lib is not evidence the gate is enforced.

payload.impact: A row deliberately time-gated by its author is invisible to only ONE lane. ILC, RLC and SECONDARY-drain will pick and dispatch it immediately. Stamping next_recheck_not_before therefore buys DECORATIVE protection on 3 of 4 dispatch paths — a false sense of deferral.
payload.live_instance: FIX-MARKETDB-20260826-RESTORE-DROPPED-12205-FF5M-AND-54-EVIDENCE-ROWS-STILL-RECOVERABLE sits P0/READY/next_agent=ops at ready[] head with NO gate field. It is deliberately deferred to 08:00Z (market close; peer db-data-integrity cron sweeps the same recovering DB every 30min). Router held it this tick with a task-lock busy-guard (ttl 2400s) because a gate field would NOT have stopped ILC.
payload.recommendation: Either (a) make ILC/RLC/SECONDARY call is_gated_not_before($now) like qa-drain does, or (b) document that task-locks are the ONLY fleet-honored deferral mechanism and stop advertising the gate keys as picker-wide. Do NOT leave both half-true.
